news.contents: Chicago Bears running back D'Andre Swift ascended into a workhorse role during a Week 7 win over the New England Patriots. After consistently playing a slight majority of the snaps for most of this season, Swift exploded last Thursday with an 86% snap share and 26 total touches. He averaged just 3.6 yards per carry, but he also impressed with four receptions and a rushing touchdown. Lamb was by far quarterback Dak Prescott's favorite weapon in the win, as he caught five of a team-high 12 targets for a team-high 74 yards and two touchdowns. news.analysis: Tucker has not kicked in the NFL since the 2024 season, following a much-publicized violation of the league's personal-conduct policy. He's now alongside fellow veteran kicker Harrison Butker in Kansas City. Butker has struggled a bit this season, and Tucker could win out between the two. The situation should become clearer as the practice week moves forward.

news.title: Justin Tucker signs with Chiefs

news.contents: The Kansas City Chiefs have signed veteran kicker Justin Tucker to their practice squad, according to The Kansas City Star's Sam McDowell. They also worked out Ben Sauls and Harrison Mevis during the week but opted for Tucker. Tucker has played 13 seasons with the Baltimore Ravens, making 89% of his kicks and earning five All-Pro and seven Pro Bowl honors.
